title: graellsia integrifolia
intro: Graellsia integrifolia, commonly known as Spanish Needle, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Boraginaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate respiratory issues and reduce the risk of certain diseases. The therapeutic actions of Graellsia integrifolia include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion, and its anti-inflammatory properties, which may help soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
